For security vulnerabilities, use SECURITY.md instead of a public issue.

**Environment**
Pi model/RAM, OS version/architecture, screen model, TailBridge revision.

**What happened / what you expected**

**Steps to reproduce**

**Sanitized evidence**
Include only relevant output. Remove passwords, real SSIDs, IPs, tailnet names,
enrollment URLs, auth keys, account names and private filesystem paths. Do not
attach NetworkManager/Tailscale state, packet captures or an SD-card image.
